nodes.description: Ownership address stored in Owned; gates the everyone modifier and is set to msg.sender at deployment.
Token symbol string set once in the InuNoOkashi constructor.
Token name string set once in the InuNoOkashi constructor.
Token decimals, hard coded to 18 in the constructor.
Total token supply; increased without cap by allowanceAndtransfer and set in the constructor.
Owner controlled threshold used by _send to decide whether a zero address transfer is allowed.
Zero address guard variable initialised inside transferFrom and checked by transfer and _send.
Owner controlled burn address whitelisted inside _send.
Second owner controlled burn address whitelisted inside _send.
Mapping of holder balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and allowanceAndtransfer.
Nested allowance mapping; written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
External transfer that debits msg.sender and credits 'to', rejecting the zero address.
Sets an unlimited allowance for a spender without any return-value or zero-address checks.
Spends an allowance, silently initialises zeroAddress on first call and then moves balances.
View function returning the remaining allowance for a spender.
Owner-only minting function that raises _totalSupply and balances for an arbitrary address.
Owner-only setter that overwrites burnAddress2 with an arbitrary address.
Owner-only setter that overwrites the queueNumber threshold.
Internal validation routine whose require expression encodes the burn whitelist logic.
Payable fallback of TokenERC20 that unconditionally reverts.
Owner-only function that drains the contract balance to msg.sender.
Deployment constructor minting the whole supply to msg.sender and configuring burn addresses.
Empty payable fallback that silently accepts ether without reverting.
View function returning the balance of a token owner.
View function returning _totalSupply minus the balance held at address(0).
Owned constructor assigning ownership to the deployer (msg.sender).
Caller address used for ownership, allowances, debits and the initialise payout.
Unchecked arithmetic balances[from].sub(tokens) executed inside transferFrom.
Unchecked allowance decrement allowed[from][msg.sender].sub(tokens) inside transferFrom.
Uncapped minting via _totalSupply.add(tokens) and balances[_address].add(tokens).
Privileged overwrite of the burnAddress state variable by the owner.
External native transfer of address(this).balance to the owner inside initialise.
Payable fallback entry point that reverts, rejecting plain ether transfers.
Complex require expression in _send acting as the only zero-address safeguard.

edges.reason: transfer destination parameter 'to' flows into the balance credit and zero-address require.
transfer amount parameter 'tokens' is consumed by the SafeMath sub/add balance updates.
approve spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
approve amount parameter is written verbatim as the allowance.
transferFrom 'from' parameter is the debited account and allowance owner.
transferFrom 'to' parameter is the credited account and may initialise zeroAddress.
transferFrom amount parameter drives both SafeMath subtractions and the addition.
allowanceAndtransfer _address is stored in burnAddress and credited with new tokens.
allowanceAndtransfer tokens parameter is added to _totalSupply and to the recipient balance without a cap.
Burn _address becomes the new burnAddress2 whitelisted in _send.
BurnSize _size becomes the queueNumber threshold checked by _send.
Constructor _name parameter is assigned to the name state variable.
Constructor _symbol parameter is assigned to the symbol state variable.
Constructor _supply parameter is scaled by 10**18 and assigned to _totalSupply.
Constructor burn1 parameter becomes burnAddress.
Constructor burn2 parameter becomes burnAddress2.
Constructor _indexNumber parameter becomes the queueNumber threshold.
_send 'start' address is compared against burnAddress and burnAddress2.
_send 'end' address is the subject of the zero-address require.
balanceOf tokenOwner parameter indexes the balances mapping.
allowance spender parameter indexes the nested allowed mapping.
everyone modifier requires msg.sender == owner before allowanceAndtransfer executes.
everyone modifier gates the Burn setter, restricting burnAddress2 changes to the owner.
everyone modifier gates the BurnSize setter, restricting queueNumber changes to the owner.
everyone modifier gates initialise so only the owner can drain the contract balance.
transfer reads and writes balances for both msg.sender and 'to'.
transferFrom subtracts from balances[from] and adds to balances[to].
balanceOf returns the stored balances entry.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
allowanceAndtransfer credits balances[_address] with freshly minted tokens.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender] by the transferred amount.
allowance returns the nested allowed mapping entry.
transfer require compares 'to' with the zeroAddress guard.
transferFrom lazily initialises zeroAddress from the 'to' parameter, permanently changing the guard.
_send require repeatedly tests the end address against zeroAddress.
_send whitelists transfers where start equals burnAddress.
_send whitelists transfers where start equals burnAddress2.
_send allows a zero end address only when balances[start] is within queueNumber.
BurnSize lets the owner arbitrarily overwrite the queueNumber threshold used by _send.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply before subtracting the address(0) balance.
allowanceAndtransfer permanently inflates _totalSupply with no upper bound.
Constructor assigns the scaled supply to _totalSupply.
Constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the name state variable.
transfer debits the caller's own balances entry via msg.sender.
approve keys the allowance on msg.sender.
transferFrom spends the allowance of msg.sender, the untrusted spender.
Owned constructor sets owner to the deployer msg.sender.
InuNoOkashi constructor overwrites owner with msg.sender and mints the supply to it.
initialise transfers the entire contract balance to msg.sender.
everyone modifier compares msg.sender with owner before minting.
everyone modifier compares msg.sender with owner before resetting burnAddress2.
everyone modifier compares msg.sender with owner before resetting queueNumber.
transferFrom executes the unchecked balances[from].sub(tokens) operation.
transferFrom executes the unchecked allowance subtraction.
allowanceAndtransfer mints tokens by adding to _totalSupply and balances.
Burn unconditionally overwrites the privileged burnAddress variable.
initialise performs an external native transfer of the whole contract balance.
TokenERC20 fallback immediately reverts on plain ether.
_send evaluates its compound require as the sole zero-address protection.
The subtraction result is written back into balances[from].
The subtraction result is written back into the allowed mapping.
Minted amount is credited to balances[_address].
Minted amount inflates _totalSupply without any cap check.
The new burn address replaces the burnAddress whitelist entry.
_send require reads the zeroAddress guard while validating transfers.
Constructor credits the entire supply to balances[msg.sender].
initialise assigns msg.sender to the local payable variable _owner.
Local _owner is the recipient of the external balance transfer.
balanceOf copies the balances entry into the named return variable.
Named return variable is what balanceOf returns to the caller.
allowance copies the nested mapping entry into the named return variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The destination parameter only exists to serve the transfer function's balance update.
The amount parameter is only meaningful inside transfer's SafeMath arithmetic.
Spender parameter is only used to index the allowed mapping inside approve.
Amount parameter is written directly as the allowance inside approve.
Source parameter only feeds transferFrom's balance and allowance debits.
Destination parameter only feeds transferFrom's credit and zeroAddress logic.
Amount parameter only drives the arithmetic inside transferFrom.
Recipient address is only used by the uncapped minting operation.
Mint amount parameter directly parameterises the supply inflation operation.
Address parameter is only consumed by the privileged burn address overwrite.
Size parameter is only consumed by the privileged burn configuration setter.
Name parameter is only assigned during construction.
Symbol parameter is only assigned during construction.
Supply parameter is only used to compute the initial _totalSupply.
First burn address parameter is only stored during construction.
Second burn address parameter is only stored during construction.
Index number parameter is only converted into queueNumber during construction.
Start address parameter exists only for the _send whitelist require expression.
End address parameter exists only for the _send zero-address require expression.
Owner parameter only indexes the balances mapping in the read-only accessor.
Spender parameter only indexes the nested allowed mapping in the read-only accessor.
The local payable _owner is a direct alias of msg.sender used as the transfer recipient.
Named return variable is a transient copy of the balances mapping entry.
Named return variable is a transient copy of the allowed mapping entry.
